analogy.rationale: Enkephalinase (MME) inhibition raises endogenous enkephalin levels, but the nine cell lines are non-neuronal and express little MME or opioid receptors, so transcriptional response should be minimal; the closest listed classes act on related neuropeptide/opioid or neurotransmitter systems but also require neuronal machinery largely absent here.
